classification.difficultyReason: Multiply the supplied conditional branch probabilities to complete outcomes, then recognise at least one strawberry as the complement of two lemon ice lollies.

inlines.text: A freezer contains 3 lemon ice lollies and 5 strawberry ice lollies.
Two ice lollies are selected at random

spec.description: Two-stage tree with full flavour labels and all six supplied branch probabilities. Editable outcome and probability responses sit beside the corresponding terminal paths.
spec.mathematics: First stage L=3/8, S=5/8; after L, L=2/7 and S=5/7; after S, L=3/7 and S=4/7.
spec.answerVisibility: All branch probabilities are permanent givens. LL is supplied separately in the first editable terminal row. Other outcomes and terminal probabilities are response clozes.

children.label: b
children.prompt: at least one ice lolly is strawberry.
